Ordinary =, <>, <, > and LIKE comparisons with NULL are UNKNOWN. Explicit IS NULL, ISNULL, CASE and branch differences are preserved in the authored behavior and exact source.

Unmodified caller values, including NULLs, pass into the listed assignments. Type conversion and target constraints can reject them; only explicitly reviewed fallback/validation branches change that rule.
